instruction: I want Chrome to block all pop-ups because they're really annoying. How do I enable the pop-up blocker?

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y
cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"session":{"restore_on_startup":4, "startup_urls":["http://funbrain.com/"]}}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

metadata.explanation: Task requires blocking pop-ups in Chrome settings. Similar complexity - navigate to Settings > Privacy and security > Site settings > Pop-ups and redirects and block them.
